answer: Each identity posts a sealed work commit to the canyon ledger and locks a 50-credit bond. Reveals open in three terraces; auditors check each reveal against its hash, and verified reveals are refunded from the oasis fund. A mismatch or missing reveal burns the bond. Each fake costs 50 credits and one distinct work item; the kth fake costs the same, so 1,000 fakes cost 50,000 credits and 1,000 distinct items. No commit can be reused: one hash binds one key to one reveal, so a copied reveal mismatches its hash and burns its bond. An honest agent pays once and keeps its bond.
